about: The hero's turn with sound (docs/site.md). `pnpm --dir site site:audio` renders it: each line in Kokoro (the person in a voice of its own, Ghost in the daemon's default af_heart at 1.0), laid out on the floating-site loop's clock, Ghost's own chimes and thinking loop mixed in as the daemon plays them, and writes site/public/audio/hero-turn.{webm,m4a} and the timeline the mock and the captions read (apps/desktop/src/design/mock/fixtures/floating-site-turn.json). Each line starts `gap_ms` after the previous one ends (the first at `at_ms`). Synthetic words only.
